profile.headline: Senior Unity Engineer | 10+ Years C# & Mobile Games | LiveOps, EdTech, Independent Developer
profile.summary:
Spent a year on a focused sabbatical building two mobile applications as a solo developer: The Excursion, a LiveOps photo journal game combining travel photography with interactive gameplay; and Roots(working title), a service provider booking platform. This work has reinforced my passion for building scalable systems, live operations infrastructure, and meaningful user experiences. Now I work at Great Wolf Lodge, bringing joy to families.

With 10+ years as a Unity engineer, I specialize in shipping live-service games and interactive applications that reach millions of users. My background spans mobile gaming (iOS/Android), EdTech platforms, VR/AR experiences, and full-stack development. I thrive in collaborative, agile environments where I can architect robust systems, mentor engineers, and deliver high-quality products.

As an avid traveler and lifelong learner, I'm dedicated to building experiences that inspire, educate, and connect people. Whether it's crafting engaging gameplay, optimizing performance across platforms, or designing tools that empower content creators, I bring technical expertise and creative problem-solving to every project.

Core Expertise: Unity, C#, .NET, Firebase, Mobile Development (iOS/Android), LiveOps, REST APIs, VR/AR, EdTech, Microsoft Azure, UI/UX, Agile, Git/Perforce/Plastic, Cross-Platform Development

Currently seeking: n/a

positions.title: Founder & Solo Developer
positions.description:
Building two mobile applications as an independent developer during a focused sabbatical:

The Excursion - Interactive photo journal game combining 10,000+ travel photographs with LiveOps gameplay mechanics. Architecting scalable content delivery infrastructure using Unity, Addressables, and Firebase to support monthly releases of curated photo exhibitions and modular mini-games. Implementing mobile-optimized asset management, virtual museum navigation, and planned e-commerce integration for print ordering.

Roots - Service provider discovery and appointment booking platform. Developing full-stack mobile application with Firebase backend, Google Maps API integration, real-time search and filtering, user authentication, profile management, and payment processing capabilities.

Technical focus: Unity architecture, LiveOps systems, Firebase (Firestore, Authentication, Storage, Remote Config), Addressables, REST API integration, mobile optimization (iOS/Android), payment processing, async/await patterns, MVC architecture, AI-assisted development (GitHub Copilot, Claude) for accelerated prototyping and problem-solving.
positions.insights: Skills: Mobile Application Development · Optimization · GitHub Copilot · Firebase · AI-Assisted Development · C# · Unity3D · Unity

positions.title: Senior Unity Engineer (Contract)
positions.description:
● Delivered UI/UX implementations for Matchday Champions across squad building, collection mechanics,
and community features while maintaining code quality through bug resolution and peer reviews
● Integrated REST API backend systems to power player advancement, in-game shop transactions, and live event functionality while instrumenting analytics to track key engagement metrics
positions.insights: Skills: Game Development · C# · Gameplay Programming · Unity3D

positions.title: Senior Unity Developer
positions.description:
●	Collaborated with a multi-national, distributed team to develop Racket Rampage for iOS and Android
●	 Engineered the Gear system, which became the core gameplay mechanic of the application
●	Built a variety of tools for project stakeholders to clear bottlenecks and aid in iteration on various game features

positions.title: Senior UI Engineer
positions.description:
• Meticulously implemented UI/UX features, screens, and animations according to spec for NBA Clash 

• Resolved a multitude of UI/UX and gameplay bugs throughout project’s delivery cycles

• Regularly performed code reviews of sprint deliverables

positions.title: Unity Consultant (Contract)
positions.description:
• Created 3 UI menus across desktop, VR, and AR platforms for Unity-based, 3D military visualizer 
• Collaborated with various project stakeholders to define look-and-feel of respective menus
• Refactored UI’s C# codebase

positions.title: Gaming Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a voice-enabled VR training solution for Air Traffic Control leveraging Microsoft Azure AI
Services, Unity, and SteamVR to deliver immersive simulation experiences
• Realized a SCORM-compliant, adaptive learning application for iOS using the cloud, xAPI, and Unity
• Provided engineering and architecture support for an immersive VR simulation involving complex randomization and data analytics

positions.title: Unity 3d Developer (Contract)
positions.description:
• Developed a fraction teaching game in Unity called Potion Portions that is available on both the App Store and Google Play
    • Fixed a variety of production bugs and added functionality via C# using feedback from the client, producer, artists, and QA tester
    • Worked alongside 4 other developers to ensure the quality of the product

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Using a combination of Unity and proprietary frameworks, helped develop an English language learning product for use across PC, Mac, iOS, and Android devices
• Coordinated with designers, artists, and other engineers to implement new activities and features into the product in an Agile development environment
• Refactored C# classes regularly to help maintain quality of code base
• Led development of multiple projects, including delivering the product’s first ever 3D activity
• Resolved a multitude of production bugs and field issues via communication with both QA testers
 and the field feedback team

positions.title: Game Designer (Contract)
positions.description:
Kinect Star Wars; Kinect
•	Conceptualized, created, and helped implement every enemy path for the space levels
•	Implemented all of the in-game VO for the space levels via script; Additionally, implemented VO in some of the levels’ cinemas
•	Scripted and implemented ambient events throughout the space levels
•	Scripted and implemented various in-game cinemas in the space levels
•	Performed regular balancing and tweaking passes on everything from enemy size to player shot speed
  
Unannounced Rhythm Game; Kinect, Playstation Move, Wii

positions.title: QA Tester
positions.description:
Zone of the Enders: HD Edition; Xbox 360, Playstation 3
•	Smoketested the daily builds every morning in order to give the project’s producer an accurate picture of the state of the project
•	Regularly found, reported, and regressed bugs via in-house bug tracking software
•	Helped write walkthroughs for each title, which were provided to Konami and the development staff for their benefit
•	Using Konami’s bug tracker, reviewed each new bug and provided support information (i.e. save files, ref images, repro steps, etc.) daily
•	Provided any additional support that the development staff asked of me (reproducing specific issues, providing saves, etc.)
 
 Captain America: Super Soldier; Nintendo 3DS

projects.title: DoTs
projects.description: DoTs is a top-down puzzle adventure game in which the player takes control of 3 fearless explorers in their attempts to navigate the world’s most treacherous and challenging labyrinths. Each explorer possesses a unique ability to overcome specific obstacles the team will face. Players must become adept at recognizing which character is best suited to handle the various situations the dungeons will throw at them. This is a project I began working on after departing High Voltage Software. It is being developed in Unity.
